notes.0000: DRI SMALL/CLEAR startup. The C recreation should use the maintained project runtime.
notes.011c: Writes vector 0 at physical 0000:0000. No save/restore is visible here; do not transplant this runtime into the new tool.
notes.01ee: Accepts V,F,D,L,R,B after the switch character. Replaces switch pairs with spaces, then checks drive operands; defaults to current drive.
notes.0331: BDOS 12 low byte must be >= 32h. AH=10h selects DOS Plus; other accepted products use the Concurrent DOS path. This is not a sufficiently precise compatibility guard for a new port.
notes.0429: CDOS: set P_KEEP, open MXdisk (135), read queue (137). Original does not check these return codes.
notes.0477: CDOS: write MXdisk (139), clear P_KEEP; /F additionally resets all drives. Original clears KEEP rather than restoring its prior state.
notes.04f5: Reset/select drive, reject open files and nonphysical/non-FAT media, allocate caches/state, scan FAT/directories/lost chains, flush and summarize.
notes.0c68: Cluster 0 means fixed root directory. Subdirectories follow their cluster chain.
notes.0cd9: Skips deleted/end/dot entries; handles labels, directories and hidden files; diagnoses cross-links, missing EOF and file-size disagreement.
notes.11da: /L recovery heuristic: requires adjacent directory-entry start to equal start+rounded file length and the proposed FAT entries to be free.
notes.1438: Splits requests at DPB track boundaries. Original prints read errors but continues advancing: the C port must not repair data derived from a failed read.
notes.14d3: Physical write primitive has no /F guard itself; callers must enforce the read-only contract.
notes.156e: FAT12: packed odd/even 12-bit entries in memory. FAT16: cached sector entries. Values above bad-cluster marker normalize to FFFFh.
notes.161c: Updates cached FAT state and dirty flags; preserving the adjacent nibble for FAT12 is essential.
notes.1a38: Prints the no-/F warning once. This is a diagnostic, not the physical write gate.
notes.1b54: BDOS154 returns SYSDAT. CDOS uses SYSDAT:68h -> PD +10h for UDA; DOS Plus uses SYSDAT:4Eh.
notes.1ba4: DPH table: CDOS 0C18h, DOS Plus 0F08h. DPH+8 points to the 29-byte DPB.
notes.1bc9: Reads SYSDAT:88h as the open-drive vector.
notes.1bd2: BDOS156 returns PD; bit 0002h at PD+6 is set or cleared.
notes.1bfe: Stack IOPB: drive/count, track, sector, DMA segment, DMA offset. DS=SYSDAT, ES=UDA; far call through SYSDAT:28h with AX=10/11.
notes.1c2c: BDOS111 block console output with address, segment, length packet.
notes.1c5a: Original printf uses a 132-byte local buffer. New code should bound formatted output.
notes.200c: Compiler long-arithmetic helpers operate on stack operands; replace with C unsigned long, not hand-ported stack tricks.
